content: Chrome Web Store review: 'For most extensions, review is completed within a few days, but it can take up to a few weeks'; contact support past three weeks. Slower/manual review is triggered by new developers, new extensions, dangerous permission requests, broad host permissions such as *://*/*, sensitive execution permissions, significant code changes, and extensive or hard-to-review code. On rejection the publisher gets an email naming the policy; the existing listing and published CRX are unaffected and users are not notified; appeal via the Appeal button on the item detail page. Developer account: one-time 5 USD fee, permanent unchangeable account email, 2-Step Verification mandatory, verified contact email required.
